title: Maragha Observatory
summary: Construction of the Maragha Observatory began in 1259 near Maragheh in north-western Iran. The Mongol ruler Hulegu agreed to build it and Nasir al-Din al-Tusi directed it. It became operational in 1262, with a copper wall quadrant about 4 metres across and a library, and from its observations Tusi produced the Zij-i Ilkhani.

uncertainty.note: Start is the year construction began; end is the year it became operational.
